verdict.rationale: Limitless is a cloud-based AI wearable and memory service, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack contains no evidence of a setting or policy that keeps user data out of model training. Per-lifelog and per-chat deletion, full-account deletion, and data export are adjacent data controls, not a training opt-out. The community's cloud-privacy concerns do not address training use either way.
